mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 5.0% in a month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales (each falling by more than 2% from the previous month) indicates a broad-based consumer demand collapse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 2% from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), a sharp drop in manufacturing output signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high core consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually compresses real equity valuations by increasing real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0% annually (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly change in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below -50,000, it signals a sharp deterioration in the labor market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < -50000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a negative GDP growth rate (GDPC1) indicates a severe economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST declines by more than 2% and GDPC1 is negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a period of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95), a sharp drop in manufacturing output signals an imminent recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
